title: Small & Micro Wedding Venues in NYC, With Prices
description: 7 small and micro wedding venues in New York, $595 to $3,000, each price from the venue's own site. Checked Oct 28, 2026.
h1: Small & micro wedding venues in New York
eyebrow: New York · prices from the venues' own pages
answer_html:
As of Oct 28, 2026, small wedding venues in New York start at $595 for a group of 10 or more (Occasions Hall (Queens Party Hall)). Couple-only chapels start at $595, and the 7 venues we verified go up to $3,000.

Each price and guest count is quoted from the venue's own website and shows the day we read it.
oneliner: 7 venues with printed prices, $595 to $3,000 (checked Oct 28, 2026).

facts_note: A price is for the package the venue names, on the day we read it. Ask the venue about dates, taxes and fees.

ideas_lead: A venue is one line of the budget. One real find in each of the other categories, each from its own page and dated.

faq.q: What is a normal cost for a wedding venue in NYC?
faq.a: We do not quote an average, because an average hides what each venue actually prints. On this page 7 venues print prices from $595 to $3,000, each quoted from its own website on Oct 28, 2026.

faq.q: What are some cheap wedding venues in NYC under $1,000?
faq.a: 2 of the 7 venues print a price under $1,000: Occasions Hall (Queens Party Hall) $595; NYC Wedding Factory $650. Prices are for the package or hours each venue names, so read the row before you book.

faq.q: What is a small wedding considered?
faq.a: There is no official cutoff, so we use each venue's own words: the guest limits printed on this page run from 8 to 80 people. Every venue here prints its price for a small, micro, weekday or elopement booking.

faq.q: How much does a micro wedding cost in NYC?
faq.a: The venue prices we verified run $595 to $3,000. Add the sample finds on this page (a $250 dress, $150 flowers, $500 photos) to the cheapest venue and you get about $1,495 before catering, rings and tax.

faq.q: Is $5,000 enough for a wedding in NYC?
faq.a: For a small group it can be: the cheapest verified venue ($595) plus the sample finds comes to about $1,495, and even the most expensive venue here is $3,000. A 100-guest wedding is a different budget, because this page prices small groups only.
